notes:
### 🚀 v8.0.0 — Major Release (Context-Aware Global Search, Recent Items, Continue Where You Left Off & Local-First Draft Recovery) (Current)

- **Context-Aware Global Search & Deep Navigation**: Enhanced Global Search into a unified, context-aware command layer across 13 core entities (Codenames, Employees, Filenames, Branches, Leaves, Leave Comments, Quotations, Quotation File Types, Mistakes, Dates, Users, Quote Rules, and Login Codes) with entity grouping, action badges, and direct deep links.
- **Global Search Recent Items**: Lightweight, local recent history experience displaying frequently and recently accessed entities when search opens with an empty query, enabling instant re-navigation.
- **Continue Where You Left Off**: Local-first persistence of user navigation state (active routes, subtabs, date/month/year filters, branch selections, and scroll positions), smoothly restoring exact working context upon app reopening or page reload.
- **Local-First Draft Recovery & Unsaved Form Protection**: Comprehensive protection against accidental navigation, page reloads, and app restarts across Daily Quotation Entry, Leave Applications, Quotation Mistakes, Quick Import Batches, and Save File Helper.
- **Save File Outlook Rich Content Preservation**: Full markup fidelity for Outlook rich-content pastes, preserving complex tables, borders, colors, inline CSS, and layouts, with instant onPaste sync and unmount flushing to guarantee zero data loss.
